event_universe.instantiation: Every template is instantiated for every initial state at event epoch initial_state.epoch + 1; set-valued writes use the listed absolute value except revocation events, whose semantics is monotone union with the already revoked premise set.

laws.test: Replaying the same frozen ordered sequence twice from equal initial states yields exactly equal full State values or exactly equal typed rejections.
laws.sequences: all singleton templates and every ordered pair of templates for every initial state

laws.test: Applying the same accepted content-bound event twice yields exactly the once-applied full State; rejected events remain rejected without state output.
laws.cases: every event template for every initial state

laws.test: Every frozen pair with disjoint authorized coordinates commutes at a common epoch, including the two revocation events under monotone-union revocation semantics.
laws.pair_rule: all unordered accepted-template pairs whose effective write sets are disjoint, plus {e:revoke-p1,e:revoke-p2}

laws.test: The ordered pairs {e:evidence-high,e:evidence-low} and {e:custody-true,e:custody-false} produce different full states in opposite orders.
Revoking p removes exactly support families containing p, preserves every family disjoint from p, preserves all non-revocation coordinates, and multiple revocations accumulate by set union.

No accepted non-adjudication event increases authority_scopes; an attempted non-adjudication widening is rejected. Widening is accepted only for external_adjudication with authority_scopes explicitly authorized and at least one bound receipt.

mutation_operators.operator: reverse the replay order while claiming to execute the frozen order
mutation_operators.kill_requirement: at least one frozen ordered sequence detects a full-state mismatch

mutation_operators.operator: on duplicate event application add a synthetic active defeater
mutation_operators.kill_requirement: at least one duplicate-event case detects inequality
at least one designated independent pair fails to commute

mutation_operators.operator: sort overlapping events by event_id before replay
mutation_operators.kill_requirement: at least one designated noncommuting pair becomes spuriously equal

mutation_operators.operator: one revocation marks both p1 and p2 revoked
mutation_operators.kill_requirement: at least one disjoint support family is incorrectly removed
at least one authority-absent state is silently widened

hard_preconditions: The exact subject commit and all subject_bindings match.
FREEZE_V1.json is committed in an ancestor before any execution output commit.
The finite universe enumerates exactly 384 unique full initial states and 5376 event instances.
Execution uses the Python standard library plus the bound model only.
No network, protected data, manuscript input, random sampling, post-outcome tuning, or external-service output is used.
Every positive, rejected, failing, and mutation-survival case remains in its denominator.
promotion_rule: The positive terminal requires every frozen law denominator to pass, every mutation operator to be killed, no hard-precondition failure, and no resource censoring. Otherwise select the negative terminal for an observed law counterexample or the applicable CANNOT_CHECK terminal.
